poses.name: Ground
poses.description_md: Starting position. The base lies on their back with legs raised, and the flyer stands at the base's feet, ready to mount.

poses.name: Front Bird
poses.description_md: The base's feet are in the flyer's hip creases. The flyer lies face down, horizontal and engaged, holding the base's hands or with arms out.

poses.name: Star
poses.description_md: Inversion. The base's feet are on the flyer's shoulders and the pair are hand to hand. The flyer inverts with legs split wide into a star.

poses.name: Free Shoulder Stand
poses.description_md: Inversion. The flyer's shoulders rest on the base's feet with no hands, and the flyer balances in a straight vertical line.

poses.name: Reverse Bird
poses.description_md: Also called back bird. The base's feet support the flyer's lower back, and the flyer faces up in an open back bend.

poses.name: Side Star
poses.description_md: The flyer is sideways over the base, with one of the base's feet at the flyer's hip and one hand holding the flyer's hand. The flyer's body and legs open into a star.

poses.name: Reverse Star
poses.description_md: Star with the flyer facing away from the base. The flyer is inverted with legs split wide.

poses.name: Throne
poses.description_md: The flyer sits upright on the base's feet as if on a chair, shins held by the base for balance.

poses.name: Folded Leaf
poses.description_md: Therapeutic pose. From front bird, the flyer folds forward over the base's feet and lets the arms and head hang.

poses.name: Straddle Bat
poses.description_md: Therapeutic inversion. The flyer hangs upside down in a wide straddle, supported by the base's feet, hands free.

poses.name: Whale
poses.description_md: Therapeutic back bend. The base's feet are on the flyer's upper back and the base holds the flyer's ankles, while the flyer arches face up.

poses.name: Candlestick
poses.description_md: Inversion. The flyer's shoulders rest in the base's straight arms, and the flyer's body is a vertical line with legs together.

poses.name: Hand to Hand
poses.description_md: Inversion. The flyer handstands in the base's hands, and the base's arms are locked straight.

poses.name: Foot to Hand
poses.description_md: The flyer stands on the base's hands, and the base's arms are locked straight up.

poses.name: Vishnu's Couch
poses.description_md: The flyer lies on their side along the base's feet, propping the head on one hand.

poses.name: Pigeon
poses.description_md: Reverse bird variation. The flyer bends one knee and reaches back to hold that foot.

transitions.name: Ground to Front Bird
transitions.description_md: Standing entry. The base sets their feet in the flyer's hip creases, takes the flyer's hands and lifts them into front bird.

transitions.name: Front Bird to Free Shoulder Stand
transitions.description_md: The flyer folds forward and places their shoulders on the base's feet, then lifts the legs into a free shoulder stand.

transitions.name: Corkscrew Up
transitions.description_md: The flyer spirals down from front bird onto the base's feet at the shoulders and inverts into star.

transitions.name: Corkscrew Down
transitions.description_md: Reverse of corkscrew up. The flyer spirals out of star and back into front bird.

transitions.name: Front Bird to Ground
transitions.description_md: Dismount. The base bends their legs to lower the flyer until the flyer's feet reach the floor.

transitions.name: Front Bird to Throne
transitions.description_md: The base bends their knees to bring the flyer upright, and the flyer sits on the base's feet.

transitions.name: Throne to Front Bird
transitions.description_md: The flyer leans forward and the base walks their feet back into the flyer's hip creases.

transitions.name: Throne to Reverse Bird
transitions.description_md: The flyer turns to face away, and the base moves their feet to the flyer's lower back.

transitions.name: Reverse Bird to Throne
transitions.description_md: The flyer sits up, and the base moves their feet under the flyer's sitting bones.

transitions.name: Reverse Bird to Ground
transitions.description_md: Dismount. The base lowers the flyer until the flyer's feet reach the floor behind the base's head.

transitions.name: Reverse Bird to Pigeon
transitions.description_md: The flyer bends one knee and reaches back to hold the foot.

transitions.name: Pigeon to Reverse Bird
transitions.description_md: The flyer releases the foot and extends back into reverse bird.

transitions.name: Front Bird to Folded Leaf
transitions.description_md: The pair let go of hands, and the flyer folds forward over the base's feet to relax.

transitions.name: Folded Leaf to Front Bird
transitions.description_md: The pair take hands again, and the flyer lifts back up to horizontal.

transitions.name: Folded Leaf to Straddle Bat
transitions.description_md: The base walks their feet toward the flyer's inner thighs, and the flyer opens into a hanging straddle.

transitions.name: Straddle Bat to Ground
transitions.description_md: Dismount. The flyer places their hands on the floor, and the base lowers them into a roll-out.

transitions.name: Star to Side Star
transitions.description_md: The flyer rotates a quarter turn onto their side while the base keeps one hand and one foot connected.

transitions.name: Side Star to Star
transitions.description_md: The flyer rotates back to face the base and inverts into star.

transitions.name: Star to Reverse Star
transitions.description_md: The flyer turns to face away from the base while staying inverted.

transitions.name: Side Star to Vishnu's Couch
transitions.description_md: The flyer lowers onto their side along the base's feet and props the head on one hand.

transitions.name: Ground to Whale
transitions.description_md: The flyer stands at the base's head, and the base places their feet on the flyer's upper back and holds the flyer's ankles before lifting.

transitions.name: Ground to Candlestick
transitions.description_md: The flyer stands at the base's head, places their shoulders in the base's hands and lifts their legs up.

transitions.name: Candlestick to Hand to Hand
transitions.description_md: The flyer moves their hands into the base's hands and presses up into a handstand.

transitions.name: Ground to Foot to Hand
transitions.description_md: The flyer stands at the base's head and steps into the base's hands, and the base presses the flyer up to straight arms.

transitions.name: Free Shoulder Stand to Front Bird
transitions.description_md: The flyer lowers their legs and rolls forward off the shoulders, and the base catches the hips back in front bird.

transitions.name: Reverse Star to Star
transitions.description_md: The flyer turns back to face the base while staying inverted.

transitions.name: Whale to Ground
transitions.description_md: Dismount. The base lowers their legs and the flyer's feet come down to the floor behind the base's head.

transitions.name: Hand to Hand to Candlestick
transitions.description_md: The flyer lowers their shoulders into the base's hands and brings the legs together.

transitions.name: Foot to Hand to Ground
transitions.description_md: Dismount. The base bends their arms and the flyer steps down to the floor.

transitions.name: Vishnu's Couch to Side Star
transitions.description_md: The flyer takes the base's hand again and opens back up into side star.
